summary: The diff implements nearly all requirements from REQ-18 through REQ-31. New components are added for CompareReels, WhyReelsGoViral, WhatWeLearned, ViralMeter, EngagementBarChart, GrowthCurveChart, and DecayCurveChart. Existing calculators are updated with emoji input prefixes, gradient headings, loading spinners, and bounce animations. The color scheme is overhauled to the neon palette. However, the result card entrance animation (REQ-21) and the header tagline update (REQ-30) are not clearly evidenced in the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add smooth entrance animations (scale-in + fade-in, 300-500ms) to result displays across all three calculators when a result appears.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows ResultCard.tsx has no entrance animation classes or keyframe styles. The calculators use a key prop to force re-mount but no animation CSS such as animate-in, scale-in, or fade-in transitions is visible in the ResultCard or calculator components. The 300-500ms scale+fade requirement is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the app header tagline to 'Virality is Mathematics, Not Magic.' with gradient text styling, replacing or consolidating any duplicate taglines.
missing_requirements.reason: The App.tsx diff is truncated and does not show the header section. There is no evidence the tagline 'Virality is Mathematics, Not Magic.' was added or that any existing tagline was consolidated or replaced.

hallucinated_features.description: WhyReelsGoViral component includes six factors instead of the three required.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-29 specifies exactly three factors: high watch time, more shares, and a strong hook in the first 3 seconds. The diff adds three additional unrequested factors: high comment engagement, trending audio, and vertical full-screen format.
